Original source context
public class If3{
    public static void main(String[] args){
        if (args.length == 0){
            System.out.println("No values");
        }
        else{
            for (int i=0; i < args.length; i++){
                System.out.print(args[i]);
                if (i != args.length - 1){
                    System.out.print(",");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
